description: Get the most recent FTC enforcement actions (cases and proceedings), newest first — new complaints, settlements, and orders across both competition and consumer-protection enforcement. Optionally restrict to merger enforcement only or non-merger (conduct) enforcement only. Answers "what has the FTC done recently" / "what merger actions has the FTC taken this month." Example: ftc_recent_actions({ days: 30, category: "merger", limit: 10 }).

category.description: Restrict to merger enforcement, non-merger (conduct) enforcement, or both ("any", the default).

days.description: How many days back from today to look, by last-updated date. Default 30.

limit.description: Max actions to return, newest first. Default 20, max 100.

name: ftc_recent_actions
title: Ftc Recent Actions
